CapacityEvidenceKind.description:
Provenance of a machine capacity claim.

``UNOBSERVED`` is a first-class value, not an error: it is how the platform
states that capacity for this store-class is not known.
CapacityEvidenceKind.title: CapacityEvidenceKind

CoverageState.description:
Distinct partition coverage evaluation states.

Maintains crisp separation between:
- COMPLETE: fully observed, tested, and complete partition with >= 1 items.
- EMPTY: fully observed and complete partition with 0 items (affirmative negative evidence).
- SATURATED: upstream capacity, bbox POI cap, or rate limit hit; sub-partition refinement required.
- TRUNCATED: pagination limit or record cutoff hit; result set is incomplete.
- PARTIAL: partial coverage or unobserved sub-partitions; cannot claim full partition coverage.
- SOURCE_ERROR: provider or network error encountered during partition extraction.
- UNKNOWN: uncollected, unobserved, or unverified partition state.
CoverageState.title: CoverageState

CoverageState.description:
Distinct partition coverage evaluation states.

Maintains crisp separation between:
- COMPLETE: fully observed, tested, and complete partition with >= 1 items.
- EMPTY: fully observed and complete partition with 0 items (affirmative negative evidence).
- SATURATED: upstream capacity, bbox POI cap, or rate limit hit; sub-partition refinement required.
- TRUNCATED: pagination limit or record cutoff hit; result set is incomplete.
- PARTIAL: partial coverage or unobserved sub-partitions; cannot claim full partition coverage.
- SOURCE_ERROR: provider or network error encountered during partition extraction.
- UNKNOWN: uncollected, unobserved, or unverified partition state.
CoverageState.title: CoverageState

TimeContract.description:
Versioned temporal envelope shared by EMGI contracts.

Observation fields are optional because providers do not expose every
timestamp.  Their absence remains explicit.  Feature and label envelopes
impose stronger requirements, and production materializations always need
explicit knowledge and build cutoffs.
